messages:
nisha: Heads-up — CI is failing on the audit-event-validation job on master after the RBAC enum change. 3 failing tests related to actor.role values.

sam: I saw that early this morning. Failing assertion is an enum mismatch against golden fixtures.

olivia: yep, I merged the ORG_ADMIN role yesterday (small acl improvement). I regenerated golden fixtures locally but didn't realize CI validator was still pinned to older schema.

mike: failing output from the validator job:
```
AssertionError: event[0].actor.role: value "ORG_ADMIN" is not one of allowed enum values
Expected: ["USER", "ADMIN", "SERVICE"]
Actual: "ORG_ADMIN"
Test: tests/validation/test_golden_events.py::test_golden_actor_roles
```

nisha: CI uses validator image redwood/audit-validator:v2.3.0 pinned in .ci/config.yml. Runtime (canary) already uses v2.4.0 which accepts ORG_ADMIN. So golden was regenerated against runtime, but CI still runs old validator.

sam: two options: rollback golden fixtures to previous enum OR bump validator in CI and add backward-compatible acceptance for ORG_ADMIN. Which do we prefer for customer-facing events?

olivia: we shouldn't roll back the runtime change — product asked for ORG_ADMIN. Safer to update validator and add a mapping so older consumers still see ADMIN if they expect it. Also need a migration note.

mike: agree. Suggest small validator patch: accept new enum value and add a transformer for legacy consumers. Quick patch:
```py
# in validator/enums.py
ACTOR_ROLES = {
  'USER', 'ADMIN', 'SERVICE', 'ORG_ADMIN'
}
# and a compatibility shim in validator/transform.py
def compat_role(role):
    if role == 'ORG_ADMIN':
        return 'ADMIN'  # legacy mapping for downstream consumers
    return role
```
```yaml
# .ci/config.yml
validator_image: redwood/audit-validator:v2.4.0
```

devsec-bot: CI alert: audit-event-validation job retried 2x, current status: failed. No new vulnerabilities found in updated deps.

sam: I'll open PR to bump CI image and add shim + test. Will also add a release note in ops-docs and notify customers with strict schema checks.

nisha: assign to @sam. Also add an integration test that runs validator v2.3 and v2.4 against golden set so we catch future drift.

olivia: good call. I'll add the integration matrix to the CI matrix (python 3.10 + validator versions).

mike: quick checklist before closing thread:
- [ ] PR to update validator image in CI (sam)
- [ ] Patch to validator to accept ORG_ADMIN + compat shim (sam)
- [ ] Add matrix test running old & new validator (olivia)
- [ ] Ops note + customer comm for strict consumers (nisha)

nisha: thanks team. tagging product to keep post-deploy monitoring on the audit stream for any unexpected role values. :eyes:

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-validator/pull/412 - includes tests and release note. Will monitor CI and revert golden if anything else flaps. :shipit:

mike: once CI green, let's also bump the golden-generation script to annotate which validator version generated the fixture (so future regen includes provenance).

nisha: ok closing the loop here — we'll keep the ticket open until the matrix test lands and CI stabilizes. :thumbsup:
